primary_outcome: Paired change in correct settlements observed within two seconds per measured second
secondary_outcomes: Correct and timely outcomes separately for settlement, rejection and safe stop
Observed p95/p99 separately by expected outcome and dependency-delay profile
All deadline misses, dropped arrivals, incorrect and unknown outcomes
Quote receipt overlap and collection span
Worker task-attempt and backend replay counts
population: Equal synthetic coverage of 22 fixed policy/fault cases crossed with three declared quote-delay profiles; not measured customer/provider latency or traffic frequency
trace_policy: SHA-256 rank of seed, base case ID and profile ID; identical trace and counts in both arms
changed_factor: Sequential versus parallel BPMN ordering of the three independent quote requests
expiry_scope: Preserve original eligibility/expiry and expected outcomes. The deliberately expired and not-yet-valid quotes stay in their declared states. Decision-dependent expiry crossings need a separate protocol.
overlap_scope: The functional-only long three-way overlap assertion is disabled in this derived timing population; observed overlap is reported, not required for a performance arm to pass
rate_selection: Fixed at 0.5/s before qualification; never selected from a favorable performance result
stop_rule: Stop on invalid accounting, incorrect/unsafe outcomes, source/control drift, reset, generator, telemetry, worker-evidence or cost-window failure. Retain every attempt. Deadline misses remain results and never justify replacing an arm.
observation_boundary: Scheduled arrival to first durable completion-history observation; includes 100 ms observer polling. Verification reads are separate, not pure engine time.
interpretation: Five paired changes with their median and range, not a confidence interval. Refusals and safe stops are not settlement throughput. No maximum-capacity, live-agent, real-market, production sizing or complete-cost claim.
